1.name: Accelerating Sorcery
1.tooltip: Using an Ability grants <scaleAbilityHaste>@HastePerCast@ Ability Haste</scaleAbilityHaste>, stacking infinitely, this resets each round.

2.name: Apex Inventor
2.tooltip:
Gain 100 Item Haste (equivalent to 50% Item CDR).
Item Haste reduces the cooldown %i:cooldown% of all Item Abilities.

4.name: Back To Basics
4.tooltip: Your Ultimate Ability is sealed. Gain 35% Ability Damage, <healing>Healing</healing>, <shield>Shielding</shield>, and <scaleAbilityHaste>70 Ability Haste</scaleAbilityHaste>.

5.name: Banner of Command
5.tooltip: Your ally gains a bonus @EmpowermentValue*100@% <scaleHealth>Health</scaleHealth>, <scaleAD>Attack Damage</scaleAD>, <scaleAP>Ability Power</scaleAP>, <attackSpeed>Attack Speed</attackSpeed> and Size for @BuffDuration@ seconds.

6.name: Blade Waltz
6.tooltip: Makes you untargetable while you dash at and deal 30 - 150 (+10% AD, +6% Adaptive Force) damage to enemies 8 times (deals 50% On-Hit damage).

8.name: Buckle Up
8.tooltip: Spawn a Battle Sled at the start of each combat.

9.name: Buff Buddies
9.tooltip:
You gain Crest of Cinders and Crest of Insight.
Crest of Cinders: Basic attacks Burn and Slow enemy champions. While out of combat heal a percentage of your maximum health.
Crest of Insight: Gain Ability Haste, and restore Mana and Energy each second.

10.name: Cannon Fodder
10.tooltip: You enter combat launching from a cannon.

11.name: Can't Touch This
11.tooltip: Casting your <attention>Ultimate</attention> makes you <status>Invulnerable</status> for 2 seconds (8s Cooldown).

12.name: Castle
12.tooltip:
Gain the Castle Summoner Spell.
Swap places with your ally, granting you both @PercentMovementSpeedMod*100@% Move Speed and a @TotalShield@ Shield for @MSBuffDuration@ seconds.

13.name: Celestial Body
13.tooltip: Gain <scaleHealth>1500 Health</scaleHealth>, but you deal 10% less damage.

14.name: Chauffeur
14.tooltip:
You are attached to your ally and can't move on your own.
Your bonus Move Speed is also granted to your ally, and you gain Ability Haste and Attack Speed.

15.name: Circle of Death
15.tooltip: Your <health>healing</health> and <health>Health Regen</health> deal <magicDamage>70% of the value magic damage</magicDamage> to the nearest enemy champion.

16.name: Combo Master
16.tooltip:
Gain the Electrocute and Phase Rush Keystone Runes.
  • Electrocute - Hitting 3 separate Attacks or Abilities within 3 seconds deals a burst of damage.
  • Phase Rush - Hitting 3 separate Attacks or Abilities within 4 seconds grants you Move Speed and Slow Resist for a few seconds.

17.name: Contract Killer
17.tooltip:
Each round, mark an opposing champion.
That champion takes @DamageAmp*100@% extra damage and grants an +%i:goldCoins% @Gold@ gold when killed.

18.name: Courage of the Colossus
18.tooltip: Gain <shield>150 - 450 (+4% max Health) Shield</shield> after <status>Immobilizing</status> or <status>Grounding</status> an enemy champion.

19.name: Dashing
19.tooltip: Your dash, leap, blink, or teleport Abilities gain <scaleAbilityHaste>175 Ability Haste</scaleAbilityHaste>.

20.name: Dawnbringer's Resolve
20.tooltip:
When dropping below 50% Health, heal for 30% max Health over 3 seconds.
Resets on death or every 45 seconds.

21.name: Defensive Maneuvers
21.tooltip: Cast <spellName>Barrier</spellName> and <spellName>Heal</spellName> on your team. Grants <shield>@BarrierAmount@ Shield</shield>, restores <healing>@HealAmount@ Health</healing>, and gives <speed>@MoveSpeed*100@% Move Speed</speed> for 1 second.

23.name: Demon's Dance
23.tooltip:
Gain the Fleet Footwork and Grasp of the Undying Keystone Runes.
Fleet Footwork - Moving and Attacking generates charges of Energize. At 100, your next Attack deals bonus damage, heals you, and grants you a burst of Move Speed.
Grasp of the Undying - Being in combat for 3 seconds with an enemy marks them. Attacks consume the mark to deal bonus damage, heal you, and grant permanent max Health.

24.name: Die Another Day
24.tooltip: Bless the ground under you for 4s, preventing any unit inside from falling <scaleHealth>below 10% of their max Health</scaleHealth>. At the end, units inside are healed for <healing>@HealFlatTooltip@ Health</healing>.

25.name: Dive Bomber
25.tooltip: Explodes when you die, dealing <trueDamage>20% of the target's max Health as true damage</trueDamage> to nearby enemies.

26.name: Don't Blink
26.tooltip: Gain 1% bonus damage per <speed>10 Movement Speed</speed> more you have than the target.

27.name: Earthwake
27.tooltip: Your dash, leap, blink, or teleport Abilities leave behind a trail that detonates after 1 second, dealing <physicalDamage>90 - 250 (+60% stat, +125% AD) physical damage</physicalDamage>.

28.name: Erosion
28.tooltip: Damaging enemies shreds 1.5% <scaleArmor>Armor</scaleArmor> and <scaleMR>Magic Resist</scaleMR> for 4s, up to 0.01 + 20 + 10% at 20 stacks.

29.name: Ethereal Weapon
29.tooltip: Your Abilities apply On-Hit effects. 1 second Cooldown per target.

31.name: Evocation
31.tooltip: <rules> Lets you channel to restore <healing>Health</healing> and <scaleMana>Mana</scaleMana>. You then gain @MSBuffAmount*100@% Move Speed for @MSBuffDuration@ seconds.</rules>

32.name: Executioner
32.tooltip: Deal @BonusDamage*100@% more damage to enemies below @HealthThreshold*100@% health. Reset your basic abilities on takedown.

33.name: Extendo-Arm
33.tooltip: <keywordMajor>Autocast</keywordMajor> fire a Blitzcrank hook every 12 seconds at a nearby enemy champion.

34.name: Fallen Aegis
34.tooltip: Start combat with a <attention>Black Shield</attention> that blocks <shield>@ShieldAmount@ magic damage</shield> for @ShieldDuration@s. The shield prevents <status>Disabling</status> and <status>Immobilizing</status> effects until it breaks.

35.name: Feel the Burn
35.tooltip: <rules>Casts <spellName>Ignite</spellName> and <spellName>Exhaust</spellName> on all nearby enemy champions.</rules>

36.name: Firebrand
36.tooltip: Your Attacks also <keywordMajor>Burn</keywordMajor> enemies, dealing <magicDamage>0.4% max Health magic damage</magicDamage> damage per second over 5 seconds. This <keywordMajor>Burn</keywordMajor> stacks infinitely.

38.name: From Beginning to End
38.tooltip:
Gain the First Strike and Dark Harvest Keystone Runes.
  • First Strike: When you initiate champion combat, deal 10% extra damage for 3 seconds and gain Gold based on damage dealt.
  • Dark Harvest: Damaging a low Health champion inflicts adaptive damage and harvests a soul from the victim.

39.name: Frost Wraith
39.tooltip: <keywordMajor>Autocast</keywordMajor> <status>Root</status> nearby enemies for @RootDuration@ seconds every @Cooldown@ seconds.

40.name: Frozen Foundations
40.tooltip:
Gain the Frozen Foundations Summoner Spell.
Frozen Foundations summons a wall of ice at a location.

41.name: Goliath
41.tooltip: Become large, gaining <scaleHealth>35% Health</scaleHealth> and <scaleAF>15% Adaptive Force</scaleAF>.

43.name: Now You See Me
43.tooltip:
Passive: Leave a mark behind whenever you use a Movement Ability.
Active: Return to a previous mark you've left. You then gain @MSBuffAmount*100@% Move Speed for @MSBuffDuration@ seconds.

44.name: Ice Cold
44.tooltip: Your <status>Slowing</status> effects reduce <speed>Movement Speed</speed> by an extra 75.

45.name: Infernal Conduit
45.tooltip:
Your Abilities apply an infinitely stacking Burn, dealing @BleedDamagePerSecond@ magic damage per second for 3 seconds.
All your Burn effects lower your basic Ability Cooldowns by 0.08 seconds when they damage enemy champions.

46.name: Infernal Soul
46.tooltip: You gain the Infernal Soul, dealing bonus damage when you hit enemies with Abilities or Attacks.

48.name: Jeweled Gauntlet
48.tooltip:
Your Abilities can Critically Strike for 145% total damage.
Gain %i:scaleCrit% 25% (+0.04% stat) Crit Chance.

49.name: Juice Box
49.tooltip: Each round, everyone on your team gains @JuiceCount@ Juice.

50.name: Keystone Conjurer
50.tooltip:
Gain the Summon Aery and Arcane Comet Keystone Runes.
  • Summon Aery - Aery jumps onto enemies you damage or allies you Heal, Shield, or Buff, damaging enemies or Shielding allies.
  • Arcane Comet - Dealing Ability damage launches a comet, damaing all enemies in an area.

51.name: Light 'em Up!
51.tooltip: Every 4th Attack shoots 4 missiles dealing <magicDamage>44 - 320 (+140% AD, +76% Adaptive Force) magic damage</magicDamage>.

52.name: Lightning Strikes
52.tooltip:
Gain @TotalASValue*100@% total Attack Speed.
At @Breakpoint1@ Attacks per second, gain @OnHitDamage@ magic damage On-Hit.
Total Attack Speed is calculated as a multiplier of your Bonus Attack Speed

53.name: Mad Scientist
53.tooltip: On each Revive, you grow large (gaining <font color = '#8347ff'>30% Adaptive Force</font> and <scaleHealth>20% Health</scaleHealth>) or tiny (gaining 70 Ability Haste and <speed>40% Movement Speed</speed>).

54.name: Master of Duality
54.tooltip:
Your Attacks grant you 6 - 18 Ability Power and your Abilities that damage enemies grant you 3 - 9 Attack Damage.
This buff stacks and refreshes infinitely but lasts 5 seconds.

55.name: Midnight Express
55.tooltip:
Autocast throw a lantern to your ally every 12 seconds.
The lantern can be clicked to dash to you.

57.name: Mountain Soul
57.tooltip: You gain the Mountain Soul, gaining <shield>Shield</shield> after being out of combat for a short time.

58.name: Mystic Punch
58.tooltip: On-Hit reduce the cooldown of your abilities by 1.25 seconds %i:scaleCooldown%.

59.name: Mythical
59.tooltip: You can buy any number of Mythic Items.

60.name: Ocean Soul
60.tooltip: Gain the Ocean Soul, granting high <healing>Health</healing> and <scaleMana>Mana Regen</scaleMana> after damaging enemies.

61.name: OK Boomerang
61.tooltip: <keywordMajor>Autocast</keywordMajor> a boomerang at a nearby enemy every 7 seconds, dealing 40 - 200 (+30% AD, +20% Adaptive Force) adaptive damage to enemies hit.

63.name: Outlaw's Grit
63.tooltip:
After using a Dash, Blink, or Teleport Ability you gain 12 Armor and Magic Resist up to @MaxResistTooltipOnly@ at 5 stacks.
Resets every 15 seconds.

64.name: Perseverance
64.tooltip: Gain <healing>1000% base Health Regen</healing>, increased to <healing>2000% base Health Regen</healing> below <scaleHealth>25% Health</scaleHealth>.

65.name: Phenomenal Evil
65.tooltip:
Permanently gain 1 Ability Power when you damage enemy champions with Abilities.
If taken as your second Augment, starts with 40 Ability Power.
You have gained AP. Veigar would be proud!

66.name: Quantum Computing
66.tooltip: Every 30 seconds, <keywordMajor>Autocast</keywordMajor> a massive slash around you, dealing <physicalDamage>200 - 350 (+75% AD, +45% Adaptive Force) physical damage</physicalDamage>. Enemies hit by the outer half are <status>Slowed</status> by 80% decaying over 2 seconds, and take an additional <physicalDamage>10% (+0.03% AD, +0.02% stat, +0% max Health) max Health physical damage</physicalDamage>. You restore <healing>80% champion damage dealt as Health</healing>.

69.name: Repulsor
69.tooltip: On dropping below @HealthThreshold*100@% Health, <status>Knock Back</status> nearby enemies and <status>Slow</status> them for @SlowAmount*100@% for @SlowDuration@ seconds (@Cooldown@ seconds Cooldown or reset on death).

70.name: Restless Restoration
70.tooltip: You restore <healing>@HealCalcPer1000Units@ Health</healing> per 1000 distance traveled.

72.name: Searing Dawn
72.tooltip: Your Abilities mark enemies, causing them to take an additional <magicDamage>40 - 200 magic damage</magicDamage> from your ally's next Attack or Ability.

73.name: Shadow Runner
73.tooltip: After using a Dash, Blink, or Teleport Ability or exiting <stealth>Stealth</stealth>, gain <speed>300 Movement Speed</speed> for 2 seconds.

74.name: Shrink Ray
74.tooltip: Your Attacks reduce an enemy's damage by 15% for 3 seconds.

75.name: Slow Cooker
75.tooltip: Every second, apply an infinitely stacking <keywordMajor>Burn</keywordMajor> to nearby enemy champions, dealing <magicDamage>@BleedDamageTooltip@ magic damage</magicDamage> per second for @BleedDuration@ seconds.

76.name: Sonic Boom
76.tooltip: Buffing, <healing>healing</healing>, or <shield>Shielding</shield> your ally deals <trueDamage>30 - 150 true damage</trueDamage> and <status>Slows enemies surrounding them</status> by 30% for 2 seconds (2 seconds Cooldown).

77.name: Soul Siphon
77.tooltip: Gain <crit>25% Crit Chance</crit> and <lifeSteal>12% Lifesteal on <crit>Critical Strikes</crit></lifeSteal>.

79.name: Symphony of War
79.tooltip:
Gain the Lethal Tempo and Conqueror Keystone Runes.
  • Lethal Tempo - Attacking champions grants Attack Speed, stacking up to 6 times. At 6 stacks, your Attacks launch a bolt that deals additional damage.
  • Conqueror: Gain stacks of Adaptive Force when attacking enemy champions. After reaching 12 stacks, heal for a portion of damage you deal to champions.

80.name: Tank It Or Leave It
80.tooltip: You can <crit>Critically Defend</crit> using your Crit Chance (max 50% chance), giving you a chance to reduce damage taken by 20%. Gain 25% Crit Chance.

81.name: Tap Dancer
81.tooltip:
Your Attacks grant you 10 Movement Speed. Gain (+0.1% MS) Attack Speed.
The buff stacks and refreshes infinitely but lasts 5 seconds.

82.name: The Brutalizer
82.tooltip: Gain <scaleAD>@AD@ Attack Damage</scaleAD>, @AbilityHaste@ Ability Haste, and <scaleLethality>@Lethality@ Lethality</scaleLethality>.

83.name: Thief's Gloves
83.tooltip: Remove your current items, gain random items each combat instead. Bonus stats and item damage is increased by @ItemStatAmp*100@%.

84.name: Thread the Needle
84.tooltip: Gain 18% <armorPen>%i:scaleAPen% Armor Penetration</armorPen> and <magicPen>%i:scaleMPen% Magic Penetration</magicPen>.

85.name: Tormentor
85.tooltip: <status>Immobilizing</status> or <status>Grounding</status> enemy champions applies a <keywordMajor>Burn</keywordMajor>, dealing <scaleAP>@PercentMaxHPDamagePer5Seconds*20@% max Health Magic Damage</scaleAP> per second for @BleedDuration@ seconds. The <keywordMajor>Burn</keywordMajor> stacks infinitely.

86.name: Trueshot Prodigy
86.tooltip: When you damage someone from over @SnipeDistance@ units away, fire a <abilityName>Trueshot Barrage</abilityName>, dealing <magicDamage>@Damage@ magic damage</magicDamage>. @Cooldown@s per target cooldown.

87.name: Typhoon
87.tooltip: Your Attacks shoot a missile at an additional target, dealing 30% damage and applying On-Hit effects.

88.name: Ultimate Revolution
88.tooltip: Refresh your <attention>Ultimate</attention> after casting it (75 seconds Cooldown or reset on death).

89.name: Vanish
89.tooltip: Become <keywordStealth>Invisible</keywordStealth> for @StealthDuration@ seconds or until you Attack or use an Ability.

91.name: Virtuous Cycle
91.tooltip: Your <healing>Heals</healing> grans an extra <shield>@ShieldFromHealPercentage*100@% Shield</shield> and your <shield>Shields</shield> grant an extra <healing>@HealFromShieldPercentage@% Healing</healing>.

92.name: Vulnerability
92.tooltip:
Your Item and damage over time effects can Critically Strike for 145% extra damage.
Gain %i:scaleCrit% 25% Crit chance.

93.name: Warmup Routine
93.tooltip:
Gain the Warmup Routine Summoner Spell.
Channel your inner dancer to increase your damage by 2% per second, up to @MaxStacks*100@% max.

94.name: Willing Sacrifice
94.tooltip: The first time an allied champion drops below <scaleHealth>@AllyHealthThreshold*100@% Health</scaleHealth>, trade <scaleHealth>@CurrentHealthToDrain*100@% of your current Health</scaleHealth> to grant them a <shield>shield equal to @ShieldToGrant*100@% of your current Health</shield>.

95.name: Windspeaker's Blessing
95.tooltip: Your <healing>Healing</healing> and <shield>Shielding</shield> also increases the target's <scaleArmor>Armor</scaleArmor> and <scaleMR>Magic Resist</scaleMR> by 30 - 60 for 3 seconds.

96.name: Wisdom of Ages
96.tooltip:
Gain 1 level now, and 1 bonus level every other round.
Your level cap is removed.
If taken after round @RoundCounterForBonus@, gain @BonusForLatePick@ additional levels.
Leveling this augment instantly grants you levels

99.name: Zhonya's Epiphany
99.tooltip: Puts you in Stasis for 3 seconds, rendering you Untargetable and Invulnerable for the duration but also unable to act, and resetting your basic ability cooldowns.

102.name: Don't Chase
102.tooltip: You become Ghosted and leave a trail of poisonous gas behind you, dealing <magicDamage>@DamagePerSecond@ magic damage</magicDamage> per second to enemies inside.

103.name: Bread And Butter
103.tooltip: Your Q Ability gains 100 Ability Haste.

104.name: Minionmancer
104.tooltip: Your summons gain 40% increased size, health, and damage.

105.name: Homeguard
105.tooltip: Gain <speed>100% Movement Speed</speed>, disabled for 6 seconds after taking damage.

107.name: Twice Thrice
107.tooltip: Every @ProcCadence@ attacks, your On-Hit effects trigger a second time.

108.name: Self Destruct
108.tooltip: Every @BombDelay@ seconds <keywordMajor>Autocast</keywordMajor>, attach a bomb to yourself, it explodes, dealing <trueDamage>@MaxHealthDamage*100@% max Health true damage</trueDamage> and <status>Knocks Up</status> nearby enemies for @KnockupDuration@ seconds.

109.name: Oathsworn
109.tooltip:
Replace Flee with Fate's Call.
Fate's Call making your ally Untargetable for up to 4 seconds. your ally can launch themself out, Knocking Back enemies.

110.name: Clothesline
110.tooltip: There is a tether connecting your team, deals constant <magicDamage>@BurnDamageTooltip@ magic damage</magicDamage> per second to those it touches.

112.name: Ultimate Unstoppable
112.tooltip: After using your Ultimate, you become immune to <status>crowd control</status> for 3 seconds. (8 second Cooldown).

113.name: Skilled Sniper
113.tooltip:
Snipe an enemy with a non-Ultimate Ability refunds 80% Cooldown (65% for periodic Abilities).
Snipe - Damage enemies over 600 distance away

116.name: Flashy
116.tooltip: Your Flash has 3 charges. After 120 seconds, regain all charges.

118.name: Critical Healing
118.tooltip: Your <healing>healing</healing> and <shield>Shields</shield> can Critically Strike for 40% bonus amount. Gain %i:scaleCrit% 25% Crit Chance.

120.name: Serve Beyond Death
120.tooltip:
The first time you would die each round, instead return to full Health, decaying over @DecayDuration@ seconds.
Taking down an enemy champion while your Health is decaying stops the decay and sets your Health to @TriumphPercent@% max Health.

123.name: Summoner's Roulette
123.tooltip:
Replace your Summoner Spells with random ones.
When you use a Summoner Spell, replace it with another random one on a @Cooldown@ second Cooldown.

125.name: Raid Boss
125.tooltip:
You start each round imprisoned in the center of the arena, unable to act. While imprisoned, you have up to @DamageReductionMax*100@% damage reduction and gain size, Health, Attack Damage, and Ability Power over time (max @StatIncrease*100@%).
After @ImprisonDuration@ seconds or reaching @BreakoutHealthThreshold*100@% Health, you break out, Knocking Back enemies and gaining @ShieldHealthRatio*100@% max Health Shield.

129.name: Marksmage
129.tooltip: Your Attacks deal an additional <physicalDamage>(+75% stat) physical damage</physicalDamage>.

133.name: Magic Missile
133.tooltip: Dealing Ability damage fires 3 missiles at each enemy hit, each dealing up to <trueDamage>1% max Health true damage</trueDamage> based on distance traveled.

134.name: Draw Your Sword
134.tooltip: You are now melee. Gain <physicalDamage>24% Attack Damage</physicalDamage>, <healing>24% Health</healing>, <attackSpeed>20% Attack Speed</attackSpeed>, <lifesteal>20% Lifesteal</lifesteal>, and <speed>20% Move Speed</speed> (each further increased based on Attack Range lost).

135.name: Spellwake
135.tooltip: Hitting enemies with Abilities creates a blast that deals <magicDamage>@Damage@ magic damage</magicDamage> from you to the location you hit them.

136.name: Slap Around
136.tooltip: Each time you <status>Immobilize</status> or <status>Ground</status> an enemy, gain a stack granting <scaleAF>10 Adaptive Force</scaleAF>. Lose 50% stacks on death.

141.name: All For You
141.tooltip: Your <healing>Heals</healing> and <shield>Shields</shield> are 30% stronger when used on an ally.

149.name: Impassable
149.tooltip:
Gain the Aftershock and Glacial Augment Keystone Runes.
  • Aftershock: After Immobilizing an enemy champion, gain defenses and later deal a burst of magic damage around you.
  • Glacial Augment: Immobilizing an enemy champion will spawn 3 glacial rays that Slow nearby enemies and reduce their damage to your allies.

150.name: Bread And Jam
150.tooltip: Your W Ability gains 100 Ability Haste.

151.name: Bread And Cheese
151.tooltip: Your E Ability gains 100 Ability Haste.

152.name: Quest: Steel Your Heart
152.tooltip:
QUEST: Possess Heartsteel with 300+ stacks.
REWARD: Multiply your Heartsteel stacks by 3.

156.name: Quest: Wooglet's Witchcap
156.tooltip:
Immediately gain a Needlessly Large Rod.
QUEST: Possess Rabadon's Deathcap and Zhonya's Hourglass.
REWARD: Gain Wooglet's Witchcap.

165.name: Restart
165.tooltip: Your non-ultimate abilities refresh every @CoolDown@ seconds.

166.name: Chain Lightning
166.tooltip: Dealing damage to target will also damage the nearest enemy for <trueDamage>@DamageMod*100@% damage dealt true damage</trueDamage>.

171.name: Dematerialize
171.tooltip:
Gain %i:miniAdaptiveForce% @AdaptiveForce@ Adaptive Force on takedown, once per champion per round.
Gaining this augment after round @RoundCounterForBonus@, gain %i:miniAdaptiveForce% @BonusForLatePick@ Adaptive Force.

172.name: Mirror Image
172.tooltip: When you drop below @HealthThreshold*100@% Health, briefly become Invisible then create a clone of yourself.

174.name: Laser Eyes
174.tooltip: There is a laser in the direction you are facing that deals <magicDamage>@LaserEyesTooltip@ magic damage</magicDamage> per second.

176.name: Snowball Fight!
176.tooltip:
Replace Summoner Flee with Mark.
Mark throws a snowball that marks the first enemy hit and deals damage. Recast to dash to the marked enemy.

177.name: Nesting Doll
177.tooltip:
You automatically begin Reviving yourself after @ReviveArmTime@ seconds and you can be Revived @BonusLives@ additional times. Each time you Revive, come back smaller and with @ReviveMod*100@% max Health.
When you revive, knockback enemies around you.

180.name: Big Brain
180.tooltip: Gain a <shield>(+300% stat) Shield</shield>. Resets on death or 70 seconds after depletion.

181.name: Heavy Hitter
181.tooltip: Your Attacks deal additional <physicalDamage>(+3.5% max Health) physical damage</physicalDamage>.

187.name: Flashbang
187.tooltip: Your Flash causes an explosion that deals 70 - 240 (+60% Adaptive Force, +70% AD) damage and <status>Slows</status> (resets on death).

193.name: Center of the Universe
193.tooltip: Stars orbit you, dealing <magicDamage>@StarDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> to enemies they pass through.

194.name: Fey Magic
194.tooltip: Damaging with your <attention>Ultimate</attention> <status>Polymorphs</status> enemies for 2 seconds (15 second Cooldown).

195.name: Giant Slayer
195.tooltip: Become tiny, gain <speed>20% Movement Speed</speed>, and deal between 10% and 30% bonus damage to champions based on how much larger they are than you.

198.name: Holy Fire
198.tooltip:
Healing or Shielding applies an infinitely stacking Burn to a nearby enemy, dealing up to @BurnPercentMax*100@% max Health magic damage over @BurnDuration@ seconds (min: @BurnPercentMin*100@%).
The damage scales with the relative size of the Heal or Shielding to the max Health of the champion being aided.

200.name: Blood Brother
200.tooltip:
Gain Darius's Passive Hemorrhage.
Attacks and damaging Abilities cause the target to Hemorrhage, dealing @BleedDamagePerStack@ physical damage over @BleedDuration@ seconds, stacking up to @MaxStacks@ times.
Draven gains @NoxianMightBonusAD@ Attack Damage at @MaxStacks@ Hemorrhage stacks.

204.name: Stackosaurus Rex
204.tooltip: When you gain permanent <keywordMajor>Stacks</keywordMajor> of an Ability, gain 100% more!

205.name: ADAPt
205.tooltip: Convert <scaleAD>Bonus Attack Damage</scaleAD> to <scaleAP>Ability Power</scaleAP>, and gain <scaleAP>(+15% stat) Ability Power</scaleAP>.

206.name: escAPADe
206.tooltip: Convert <scaleAP>Ability Power</scaleAP> to <scaleAD>Bonus Attack Damage</scaleAD> and gain <scaleAD>(+15% AD) Attack Damage</scaleAD>.

207.name: Hold Very Still
207.tooltip:
Gain Guerrilla Warfare
After not moving for @HoldStillDuration@ seconds, turn Invisibile until you move. When you exit this Invisibility, gain @BonusAS@ Attack Speed and @BonusMS*100@% decaying Movement Speed for @ASDuration@ seconds. Your next attack deals an additional @BonusHitDamage@ magic damage.

208.name: Orbital Laser
208.tooltip:
Replace Summoner Flee with Orbital Laser.
After a delay, call down an orbital laser that deals @DamagetoChampions*100@% max Health true damage plus @TotalDamageOverTimeTooltip@ magic damage over @GroundDuration@ seconds.

211.name: It's Killing Time
211.tooltip: After casting your Ultimate, mark all enemies and store 40% of damage you deal to them. After 5 seconds, detonate the stored damage (8 second Cooldown).

213.name: Fully Automated
213.tooltip: Your <keywordMajor>Autocast</keywordMajor> Cooldowns are reduced by @AutocastFlatCDR@ seconds and benefit from your Ability Haste.

214.name: Spin To Win
214.tooltip: Your spin Abilities gain %i:scaleAH%30 Ability Haste and deal 30% more damage, increase to @SpinDamageAmp_Ult@ for Ultimates

215.name: Dark Blessing
215.tooltip:
When you Heal or Shield an allied champion, gain @CurseCounter@ Cursed Power.
Gain Ability Haste (@AbilityHasteRatio*100@% of your Cursed Power).
@Cooldown@ second cooldown per cast.
{{ Cherry_CurseShared }}

216.name: Dreadbringer
216.tooltip:
Every @TickCadence@ second, gain @CurseStacksPerTick@ Cursed Power per nearby enemy champion.
Gain Health (@MaxHealthRatio*100@% of your Cursed Power).
{{ Cherry_CurseShared }}

217.name: Deathtouch
217.tooltip:
Attacking enemy champions grant you @CurseCounter@ Cursed Power.
Your Attacks deal an additional magic damage (@OnHitDamageRatio*100@% of your Cursed Power).
{{ Cherry_CurseShared }}

218.name: Desecrator
218.tooltip:
Immobilizing enemy champions grants you @CurseCounter@ Cursed Power.
Gain Armor and Magic Resistance (@ArmorMRRatio*100@% of your Cursed Power).
{{ Cherry_CurseShared }}

219.name: Doomsayer
219.tooltip:
Hitting an enemy champion with an ability grant you @CurseCounter@ Cursed Power.
Gain Adaptive Force (@AdaptiveForceRatio*100@% of your Cursed Power).
{{ Cherry_CurseShared }}

220.name: Fan the Hammer
220.tooltip:
When you Attack enemy champions, fire 5 missiles that each deal 8 - 50.5 (+14% AD) physical damage, increased up to 50% with distance traveled. Each cardinal direction has a 8 second Cooldown.
Each bolt can Critically Strike and applies On-Hits at 20% effectiveness.

221.name: Trailblazer
221.tooltip: When you Dash or Blink, <keywordMajor>Burn</keywordMajor> a nearby enemy for <magicDamage>@BurnPercent*100@% max Health magic damage</magicDamage> over @BurnDuration@ seconds.

222.name: Fruits of Your Labor
222.tooltip: Power Flowers are @AmpAmount*100@% more effective on you and are shared with your ally.

223.name: Summoner Revolution
223.tooltip:
Your Summoner Spells gain @BonusCharges@ additional charge(s).
Flash resets every round.

224.name: Prismatic Egg
224.tooltip:
Gain @KillStackCredit@ stack on takedown, once per champion per round.
After @RequiredKillCount@ stacks, this hatches into a Prismatic Item Anvil, %i:Augment% Prismatic Augment, and a %i:StatAnvil% Prismatic Stat Anvil.

225.name: Dual Wield
225.tooltip:
When you Attack, fire a bolt that deals 40% damage and applies your On-Hit effects at 40% effectiveness.
Gain 10% total Attack Speed.

227.name: Stats on Stats!
227.tooltip: Gain 3 Stat Anvils, with a higher chance of Gold and Prismatic Anvils!

228.name: Stats on Stats on Stats!
228.tooltip:
Gain 4 Stat Anvils, with a higher chance of Gold and Prismatic Anvils!
On your next Augment selection, gain one additional reroll per slot.

229.name: Fire Sale
229.tooltip:
Instantly sell all your non-quest items for @SellValueTooltip@% of their direct buy price. Great for all those discounted anvils.
When removed or replaced gain +%i:goldCoins% gold equal to @RemovalGoalGainPercentage*100@% of the gold gained from FireSale.

230.name: Bullet Heaven
230.tooltip:
On your Attack Timer, automatically Attack the nearest enemy with no windup. Your Attacks are also replaced with missiles that hit all surrounding enemies, and every third missile deals @BigOneDamageMultiplier*100@% damage.
You may still manually Attack Plants and Traps.

231.name: Light Warden
231.tooltip: Every @Cooldown@ seconds, <keywordMajor>Autocast</keywordMajor> a warding light towards your ally, granting <shield>@TotalShield@ Shield</shield> to yourself and allies it passes through before returning, repeating the effect..

232.name: Slime Time
232.tooltip: Every @Cooldown@ seconds <keywordMajor>Autocast</keywordMajor> a burst slime from your body, dealing <magicDamage>@BaseDamage@ plus @PercentDamage@ max Health magic damage</magicDamage> to nearby enemies. If you hit a champion, secrete a blob nearby. Walking over the blob restores <healing>@BlobHeal@ Health</healing>, while enemies destroy the blob.

233.name: Ultimate Roulette
233.tooltip:
Replace Flee with a random Ultimate. After casting the Ultimate, replace it with new random Ultimate.
These spells are still ultimates.

234.name: Gamba Anvil
234.tooltip:
Gain +%i:goldCoins%@GoldBonus@ gold and reduce the price of all anvils.
Prismatic Anvils: -%i:goldCoins%@PrismaticCostReduction@ gold
Legendary Anvils: -%i:goldCoins%@LegendaryCostReduction@ gold
Stat Anvils: -%i:goldCoins%@StatCostReduction@ gold
Items acquired from anvils resell for -%i:goldCoins%500 gold less.

236.name: Trickster Demon
236.tooltip: When you exit stealth explode for <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ Magic Damage</magicDamage>, your clones and traps will do the same on death.

239.name: Symbiotic Mutation
239.tooltip:
Every round this mutates into one of your ally's augments.
Only mutates into augments you could roll.

240.name: Parasitic Mutation
240.tooltip:
Every round this mutates into one of your opponent's augments.
Only mutates into augments you could roll.

241.name: Hat Trick
241.tooltip:
Instantly gain @HatsToGrant@ hats, and reduce the price of Cappa Juice by @HatTrickPriceReduction@.
Taking damage that would reduce your Health below @LowHealthThreshold*100@% gain @MoveSpeedBoostPercent*100@% Move Speed and a @ShieldHealth@ shield for @ShieldDuration@, but lose one hat. @Cooldown@ second Cooldown.
You no longer lose hats on round loss.

242.name: Juice Press
242.tooltip:
Your team gains additional effects from juices and buff juices cost @PriceReduction*100@% less.
Juice of Power: @PowerJuicePercentPen*100@% Armor or Magic Pen
Juice of Vitality: @VitalityJuiceHealShieldPower*100@% Healing and Shield Power
Juice of Haste: @SpeedJuiceMSBoost*100@% Movement Speed
Cappa Juice: @BonusHats@ additional hats.

250.name: Slow and Steady
250.tooltip:
Your Attack Speed can not go above @StaticRatio@. All bonus Attack Speed is converted to Attack Damage (@ADPerAS@ AD per 1% AS).
Currently Gaining: Attack Damage

251.name: Numb to Pain
251.tooltip: @MeleeReduction*100@% of damage you take instead happens over @BleedDuration@ seconds (@RangedReduction*100@% for ranged champions).

301.name: Divine Intervention
301.tooltip: Every 35 seconds, <keywordMajor>Autocast</keywordMajor> a protective star that slowly descends upon you. When it lands, you and nearby allies become <keywordMajor>Invulnerable</keywordMajor> for 2.5 seconds.

305.name: Leg Day
305.tooltip: Gain <speed>50 Movement Speed</speed> and <speed>50% Slow Resist</speed>.

308.name: Firefox
308.tooltip: <keywordMajor>Autocast</keywordMajor>: Gain <speed>25% movement speed</speed> and conjure three flames that orbit you every 7 seconds, targetting the closest visible enemy in range and dealing 35 - 160 (+25% Adaptive Force, +25% AD) adaptive damage. Subsequent hits do 30% damage.

309.name: And My Axe!
309.tooltip:
Autocast: Throws an axe at the nearest opponent every @Cooldown@s, dealing @TotalDamage@ physical damage, Slowing the target for @SlowAmount*100@% for @SlowDuration@s, and shredding @ShredAmount*100@% Armor and Magic Resist for @DebuffDuration@ seconds.
Picking up this axes reduces its Cooldown (%i:cooldown%) to @CDIfPickedUp@s.

310.name: Clown College
310.tooltip:
Backstab: You deal 20 - 35 (+35% Adaptive Force, +50% AD) bonus physical damage when striking from behind.
Deceive: You teleport and become Invisible for 3 seconds. Your next Attack while Invisible deals an additional 100 (+150% AD, +55% Adaptive Force) physical damage. If striking from behind, this Attack critically strikes for 155% damage.
Hallucinate: Death: On death, deal 25% maximum Health true damage and fear for 1s around you.

311.name: Overflow
311.tooltip: Your <scaleMana>Mana</scaleMana> costs double. Your Ability <healing>Heals</healing>, <shield>Shields</shield>, and damage are <scaleMana>1000%</scaleMana> more effective.

312.name: We'll Be Right Back
312.tooltip: <spellName>Time Stop</spellName>: All nearby champions are put in <status>Stasis</status> for @StasisDuration@ seconds, or @SelfDuration@ seconds for you. During which you restore <healing>@HealAmountPercent*100@% missing Health</healing>.

313.name: Tank Engine
313.tooltip: On takedown, gain a stack that grants 5% increased size and <scaleHealth>5% max Health</scaleHealth>. Lose 65% of stacks on death.

314.name: Unshackled
314.tooltip:
You can now Hijack your ally's ultimate.
On takedown, reduce Hijack's lockout and cooldown by @TakedownRefund*100@%.
Gain @UltimateHaste@ Ultimate Haste.

315.name: Energetic Caster
315.tooltip:
Your Energized attacks trigger your autocasts @CastCount@ time.
Divine Intervention's cooldown is reduced by @DivineInterventionCD@ seconds instead of casting.

317.name: Pandora's Box
317.tooltip: Transmute all of your augments into <keywordMajor>random Prismatic%i:Augment% Augments</keywordMajor>.

318.name: Quest: Mad Hatter
318.tooltip:
Requirement: Wear @QuestThreshold@ hats at the end of combat.
Reward: Gain @AFPerHat@ Adaptive Force, @ArmorMRPerHat@ Armor and Magic Resist, @TenacityPerHat*100@% Tenacity, and @MSPerHat@ Movement Speed per hat.
Currently Granting: Adaptive Force, Armor and Magic Resist, @f3*100@% Tenacity, and Movement Speed.
Lose half of your hats when you lose a round.

319.name: Quest: Three Sacred Treasures
319.tooltip:
Requirement: Possess Infinity Edge, Perplexity, and Hextech Gunblade.
Reward: Yunara's Attacks are replaced with lasers that deal @Calc_Physical_Damage@ physical damage + @Calc_Magic_Damage@ magic damage and apply %i:OnHit% On-Hit effects twice.

320.name: Calculated Risk
320.tooltip:
You can no longer %i:Reroll% Reroll.
Begin a %i:Augment% Gold Augment selection, if you have @AugmentThreshold@ or fewer augments gain a %i:Augment% Prismatic Augment instead.

321.name: Bodyguard
321.tooltip:
Using a dash, blink, or teleport grants yourself, and an allies you pass through, a shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds.
The strength of this shield depends on your abilities base cooldown at level 1. Shields reach their maximum on abilities with at least a @MaxCDCheck@ second cooldown.

322.name: Augmented Power
322.tooltip:
Increase the damage done by your augments and items by @DamageAmp@.
Damage increase this round:
Total damage increased:

323.name: Cerberus
323.tooltip:
Gain the Hail of Blades and Press the Attack Keystone Runes.
  • Hail of Blades - Your first 3 Attacks have massively increased Attack Speed.
  • Press the Attack - Hitting 3 Attacks against the same enemy deals a burst of damage and increases your damage until you leave combat.

324.name: Bravest of the Brave
324.tooltip: Increase future %i:Augment%Augment offerings by @tierValueIncrease@ tier(s). If the Augment's tier was already Prismatic, gain <gold>+%i:goldCoins%@GoldAmount@ gold</gold>.

326.name: Spirit Infusion
326.tooltip:
Gain @FlatHS*100@% Heal and Shield Power.
Casting your Ultimate increases your Heal and Shield Power by @AmpAmount*100@% for @HSDuration@s(@Cooldown@s cooldown).

327.name: Undying Guard
327.tooltip:
Upon activating Cultivation of War's revive, Zaahen unleashes a sweep around him that deals @TotalDamage@ plus @PercentCurrentHealthDamage*100@% current Health physical damage and Knocks Back all enemies.
Afterwards, Zaahen becomes Immune to damage from enemies outside the sweep range and gains @MovementSpeedBoost*100@% Movement Speed for @MissileDefenseBaseDuration@ seconds.

328.name: Infernal Chains
328.tooltip:
Autocast chains in every direction every @AutoCastCooldown@ seconds, dealing magic damage and sticking into enemies. Chains snap after @ChainDuration@ seconds, dealing more magic damage and Rooting for @RootDuration@ seconds.
Chains end early with no effect if shackled enemies get far enough away.

329.name: Necromancer
329.tooltip:
Every @GravestoneCooldownBase@ seconds summon @GravestonesPerSpawn@ Gravestones nearby (CD scaling down with your Bonus Mana Regen). Healing or Shielding yourself raises Gravestones as Ghouls that Attack your enemies.
Ghouls HP: @GhoulHP@
Ghouls AD: @GhoulAD@
Ghouls MS: @GhoulMS@
Ghouls AS: @GhoulAS@

330.name: Despoil
330.tooltip:
Dashing or Blinking grants you @CurseCounter@ Cursed Power if there is an enemy nearby. Gain Move Speed scaling with your Cursed Power.
Gain Move Speed (@MSRatio*100@% of your Cursed Power).
{{ Cherry_CurseShared }}

331.name: Multitool
331.tooltip:
Add Multitool to your inventory. During each Shopping Phase, choose 1 of 5 random items, and Multitool becomes that item for the next combat round.
At round @PrismaticRound@, Multitool can roll Prismatic Items.

332.name: Blood Mage
332.tooltip: Your Abilities cost <scaleHealth>@HealthCostPerAbility*100@% Health</scaleHealth> instead of <scaleMana>Mana/Energy</scaleMana> and deal up to @MaxDamageAmp*100@% increased damage based on your <scaleHealth>missing Health</scaleHealth> (max at @MaxMissingHealthPercent*100@% Health). Gain <lifeSteal>@BonusOmnivamp*100@% Omnivamp.</lifeSteal>

333.name: Quest: Rite Of The Forge God
333.tooltip:
Requirement: Purchase @AnvilsReqToComplete@ Item Anvils.
Reward: All of your items become Masterwork, increasing their stats by @ItemPercentAmp*100@%.

334.name: Hallucinate
334.tooltip:
At the start of each combat round, summon a Clone of yourself.
Clones receive @CloneIncomingDamagePercent*100@% damage from all sources. They deal @CloneAADamagePercent*100@% of your Attack Damage and apply your On-Hit effects. They can be ordered to attack and move using Alt+Click.

335.name: Panic Room
335.tooltip: Once per combat, when you would die, instead turn into a wisp, set yourself to <scaleHealth>@HealthLock*100@% Health</scaleHealth>, and travel to a random spot in the arena.

336.name: Aim for the Head
336.tooltip:
Your Critical Strike Chance is capped at @CritChanceCeiling*100@%. Convert @CritChanceToDamageRatio*100@% of Critical Strike Chance above @CritChanceCeiling*100@% into Critical Strike Damage.
Gain @CritChanceBonus*100@% Critical Strike Chance and @CritDamageBonus*100@% Critical Strike Damage.
Total Bonus Critical Strike Damage: @f1*100@%

338.name: Hive Mind
338.tooltip: Start each round with @StartingBees@ Bee, gain additonal Bees by harvesting flowers. Damaging an enemy champion sends a Bee dealing <magicDamage>@BeeDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> over @DebuffDuration@ seconds on arrival, before returning to you.

340.name: Gain a Prismatic Stat Anvil
340.tooltip:
Gain a Prismatic Stat Anvil, granting anything from this list.
+%i:scaleCritMult% Critical Strike Damage
+%i:scaleHealth% Health and Increased Size
+%i:scaleAPen% Armor Penetration
+%i:scaleMPen% Magic Penetration
+%i:scaleMS% Move Speed and Reduced Size
+%i:scaleTenacity% Tenacity
+%i:scaleHealShield% Heal & Shield Power
+%i:scaleSV% Omnivamp
+%i:goldCoins% Gold

341.name: Gain an Augment slot
341.tooltip:
Unlock your @TooltipSlotToUnlock@th %i:Augment% Augment Slot.
In @RoundsUntilFreeAugment@ rounds gain a %i:Augment% Silver Augment.

342.name: Level Augments
342.tooltip:
Remove an %i:Augment% Augment.
Gain @AugmentLevelsToGrant@ random %i:AugmentLevel% Augment Levels.
You have @LevelableAugmentCount@ %i:AugmentLevel% levelable augment(s).

343.name: Righteous Fury
343.tooltip:
Healing or Shielding increases your Ability damage by @SpellDamagePerStack*100@%, stacking infinitely for the round.
@Cooldown@s Cooldown per Ability cast, Augment, and Item.

344.name: Energetic
344.tooltip: Gain <keyword>Energized</keyword> @EnergizeAmpMovementCharge*100@% quicker. Triggering <keyword>Energized</keyword> fires a <keywordMajor>Magic Missile</keywordMajor>, dealing up to <trueDamage>@MaxHealthDamagePerMissile*100@% max Health true damage</trueDamage> based on distance traveled.

345.name: Magical Girl
345.tooltip:
Each round, a star falls over @TimeUntilStarLands@ seconds. After picking it up you transform into a Magical Girl, knocking back nearby enemies, causing them to dance for @EnemyDanceDuration@ second, while granting you @AdaptiveForce@ Adaptive Force and a @TotalShield@ health Shield.
As a Magical Girl, every @FastSpawnRate@-@SlowSpawnRate@ seconds @StarsToSpawnPerWave@ stars fall from the sky striking around you and each of your enemies, dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage to those hit.

Dancing enemies are invulnerable.
Stars rain down more frequently on enemies within @EnemycheckDistance@ range of you.

346.name: Bread Sandwich
346.tooltip:
Gain @AbilityHaste@ Ability Haste.
Casting an ability gants @MoveSpeedAmp*100@% Movement Speed for @MSDuration@ seconds.
You have become all that is feared, you have become the ultimate in food science. Men cry out for more toppings, and you whisper "No".

356.name: Silver Spoon
356.tooltip:
Deal @DamagePerSilver*100@% increased damage per %i:Augment% Silver Augment you have.
You deal @F1*100@% increased damage.

357.name: Hybrid
357.tooltip:
When you deal damage with an Attack, your next Ability deals @AbilityBoost*100@% increased damage.
When you deal damage with an Ability, your next Attack deals @AttackBoost*100@% increased damage.

358.name: Wolf's Frenzy
358.tooltip:
Lose your innate revive.
Increase your Health by @HealthPercentageMod*100@%.
If you deal damage that would leave a champion below below @ExecuteThreshold*100@% maximum health, execute them.

359.name: Lamb's Respite
359.tooltip: Gain @RevivesToGain@ additional revive, and cuts the time needed to revive in half.

361.name: Ally Demon
361.tooltip:
Vote for your team to ally with the Demons.
Allying with Demons grants an %i:AugmentLevel% Augment Level when a Hunter team is eliminated.

362.name: Ally Hunter
362.tooltip:
Vote for your team to ally with the Demon Hunters.
Allying with Demon Hunters grants you +%i:goldCoins%@BonusGold@ bonus gold when you beat a Demon team.

364.name: Replace Augment
364.tooltip: <keywordMajor>Replace</keywordMajor> one of your <keywordMajor>%i:Augment% Augments</keywordMajor> with an Augment <keywordMajor>@TierIncreaseToolTipOnly@%i:AugmentLevel% tier higher</keywordMajor>.

374.name: Rice and Chicken
374.tooltip:
Your @spell1KeyBind@ gains @DamageAmp*100@% increase damage, and @HealShieldAmp*100@% increased Healing and Shielding.
Your @spell1KeyBind@ loses @QAbilityHaste@ Ability Haste.

375.name: Rice and Fish
375.tooltip:
Your @spell2KeyBind@ gains @DamageAmp*100@% increase damage, and @HealShieldAmp*100@% increased Healing and Shielding.
Your @spell2KeyBind@ loses @AbilityHaste@ Ability Haste.

376.name: Rice and Pork
376.tooltip:
Your @spell3KeyBind@ gains @DamageAmp*100@% increase damage, and @HealShieldAmp*100@% increased Healing and Shielding.
Your @spell3KeyBind@ loses @AbilityHaste@ Ability Haste.

377.name: Combination Fried Rice
377.tooltip:
Your abilities gains @DamageAmp*100@% increase damage, and @HealShieldAmp*100@% increased Healing and Shielding.
Lose @AbilityHaste@ Ability Haste.
Casting an ability gants @MoveSpeedAmp*100@% Movement Speed for @MSDuration@ seconds.
You have become a hearty meal, your doctor cries out for more vegetables, and you whisper "No".

378.name: Transmute: Silver
378.tooltip: Fill your remaining augment slots with <keywordMajor>%i:Augment% Silver Augments</keywordMajor>.

379.name: Wild Fire
379.tooltip:
Autocast fling a bouncing fireball every @baseCooldown@s.
This fireball deals @TotalDamage@ magic damage and can bounce between yourself and enemy champions up to @MaxBounceCount@ times.

380.name: Mercy
380.tooltip:
After your team triggers Combo Breaker you become enraged causing your immobilizing effects to deal @Damage@ magic damage.
This resets at the end of the round.

381.name: Scavenger
381.tooltip:
Increase your augment count to 6. When you defeat a team, gain one of their %i:Augment% Augments, selected at random.
Augment Selections only grant %i:AugmentLevel% Augment Level Ups.
If none of their augments are valid you'll gain @GoldAmount@ gold instead.

383.name: Demonic Clasp
383.tooltip: <spellActive>Active:</spellActive> Call @ClawCount@ claw(s), pulling enemies in your direction, dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage.</magicDamage>

384.name: Spellcraft
384.tooltip:
Active: Wind up and release a burst of energy, dealing magic damage in a cone.
This spell grows more powerful as you select additional augments.
%i:SpellcraftRedShard%: +Damage
%i:SpellcraftBlueShard%: +Crowd Control
%i:SpellcraftGreenShard%: +Healing

387.name: Big Dragon Energy
387.tooltip:
Start combat with full Dragon Fury and it no longer decays while in Dragon Form.
While in Dragon Form Emberstrike's final strike does @DragonFormMulti*100@% damage.

388.name: Chroma Flux
388.tooltip:
Every @baseCooldown@ seconds Autocast fires a magical orb that sticks to the first champion, structure, or epic jungle monster hit for @DetonationTimeout@ seconds.
Hitting that target with an Attack or Ability, it detonates it, dealing @Damage@ magic damage, grants you @MSGainTotal@ Movement Speed, and @ArmorAndMRTotal@ Armor and Magic Resist for @MarkDuration@ seconds.
%i:SpellcraftRedShard%: Deal @DamagePerRedTooltip@ additional damage per %i:SpellcraftRedShard%.
%i:SpellcraftBlueShard%: Gain @MSBoostPerBlue@ Movement Speed per %i:SpellcraftBlueShard%.
%i:SpellcraftGreenShard%: Gain @ArmorAndMRPerGreen@ Armor and Magic Resist per %i:SpellcraftGreenShard% for @MarkDuration@ seconds.

389.name: Trash To Treasure
389.tooltip: When <keywordMajor>Trash To Treasure</keywordMajor> is removed or replaced gain a <keywordMajor>%i:Augment% Prismatic Augment</keywordMajor> selection.

390.name: Unstable Transmutation
390.tooltip: At the start of each round, this transforms into random augment at its max level.

391.name: Rags to Riches
391.tooltip: When <keywordMajor>Rags to Riches</keywordMajor> is removed or replaced gain <gold>+%i:goldCoins% @GoldToGrant@ gold</gold>.

393.name: Icathia's Fall
393.tooltip:
Immediately: Gain a Bami's Cinder.
Requirement: Possess Sunfire Aegis and Hollow Radiance.
Reward: Combine Sunfire Aegis and Hollow Radiance into Void Immolation.

394.name: Dust To Diamonds
394.tooltip: When <keywordMajor>Dust To Diamonds</keywordMajor> is removed or replaced gain a <keywordMajor>@AnvilsGranted@ %i:StatAnvil% Prismatic Stat Anvils</keywordMajor>.

404.name: 404 Augment Not Found
404.tooltip:
How did you find this?!?!?
Gain @HatsToGrant@ hats.

405.name: Augment 405
405.tooltip: Gain @DamageAmpPerHat*100@% damage per hat you're wearing.

1001.name: Titan's Resolve
1001.tooltip:
Dealing and receiving champion damage grants you 1 stack of Juggernauting for 6 seconds. For every 10 stacks of Juggernauting you gain 25 - 75 Adaptive Force, 5 - 10 Armor, 5 - 10 Magic Resist, 10% Size, and 8% Tenacity.
Stacks fall off faster the more you have.
Maximum Juggernauting Level:

1002.name: Apex Inventor
1002.tooltip:
Gain 100 Item Haste (equivalent to 50% Item CDR).
Item Haste reduces the cooldown %i:cooldown% of all Item Abilities.

1004.name: Back To Basics
1004.tooltip: Your Ultimate Ability is sealed. Gain 35% Ability Damage, <healing>Healing</healing>, <shield>Shielding</shield>, and <scaleAbilityHaste>70 Ability Haste</scaleAbilityHaste>.

1005.name: Wee Woo Wee Woo
1005.tooltip:
Gain up to 50% Move Speed toward nearby allies based on their missing Health. Your healing and shielding are also increased up to 50% based on the target's missing Health.
Bonus Healing:

1006.name: Blade Waltz
1006.tooltip: Makes you untargetable while you dash at and deal 30 - 150 (+10% AD, +6% Adaptive Force) damage to enemies 8 times (deals 50% On-Hit damage).

1009.name: Buff Buddies
1009.tooltip:
You gain Crest of Cinders and Crest of Insight.
Crest of Cinders: Basic attacks Burn and Slow enemy champions. While out of combat heal a percentage of your maximum health.
Crest of Insight: Gain Ability Haste, and restore Mana and Energy each second.

1011.name: Can't Touch This
1011.tooltip: Casting your <attention>Ultimate</attention> makes you <status>Invulnerable</status> for 2 seconds (8s Cooldown).

1013.name: Celestial Body
1013.tooltip: Gain <scaleHealth>1500 Health</scaleHealth>, but you deal 10% less damage.

1015.name: Circle of Death
1015.tooltip: Your <health>healing</health> and <health>Health Regen</health> deal <magicDamage>70% of the value magic damage</magicDamage> to the nearest enemy champion.

1018.name: Courage of the Colossus
1018.tooltip: Gain <shield>150 - 450 (+4% max Health) Shield</shield> after <status>Immobilizing</status> or <status>Grounding</status> an enemy champion.

1019.name: Dashing
1019.tooltip: Your dash, leap, blink, or teleport Abilities gain <scaleAbilityHaste>175 Ability Haste</scaleAbilityHaste>.

1020.name: Dawnbringer's Resolve
1020.tooltip:
When dropping below 50% Health, heal for 30% max Health over 3 seconds.
Resets on death or every 45 seconds.

1023.name: Demon's Dance
1023.tooltip:
Gain the Fleet Footwork and Grasp of the Undying Keystone Runes.
Fleet Footwork - Moving and Attacking generates charges of Energize. At 100, your next Attack deals bonus damage, heals you, and grants you a burst of Move Speed.
Grasp of the Undying - Being in combat for 3 seconds with an enemy marks them. Attacks consume the mark to deal bonus damage, heal you, and grant permanent max Health.

1025.name: Dive Bomber
1025.tooltip: Explodes when you die, dealing <trueDamage>20% of the target's max Health as true damage</trueDamage> to nearby enemies.

1026.name: Don't Blink
1026.tooltip: Gain 1% bonus damage per <speed>10 Movement Speed</speed> more you have than the target.

1027.name: Earthwake
1027.tooltip: Your dash, leap, blink, or teleport Abilities leave behind a trail that detonates after 1 second, dealing <physicalDamage>90 - 250 (+60% stat, +125% AD) physical damage</physicalDamage>.

1028.name: Erosion
1028.tooltip: Damaging enemies shreds 1.5% <scaleArmor>Armor</scaleArmor> and <scaleMR>Magic Resist</scaleMR> for 4s, up to 0.01 + 20 + 10% at 20 stacks.

1029.name: Ethereal Weapon
1029.tooltip: Your Abilities apply On-Hit effects. 1 second Cooldown per target.

1032.name: Executioner
1032.tooltip: Deal @BonusDamage*100@% more damage to enemies below @HealthThreshold*100@% health. Reset your basic abilities on takedown.

1034.name: Veil of Warding
1034.tooltip: Gain a <attention>Spell Shield</attention> every 30 seconds that blocks the next enemy Ability.

1035.name: Feel the Burn
1035.tooltip: <rules>Casts <spellName>Ignite</spellName> and <spellName>Exhaust</spellName> on all nearby enemy champions.</rules>

1036.name: Firebrand
1036.tooltip: Your Attacks also <keywordMajor>Burn</keywordMajor> enemies, dealing <magicDamage>0.4% max Health magic damage</magicDamage> damage per second over 5 seconds. This <keywordMajor>Burn</keywordMajor> stacks infinitely.

1038.name: From Beginning To End
1038.tooltip:
Gain the First Strike and Dark Harvest Keystone Runes.
  • First Strike: When you initiate champion combat, deal 10% extra damage for 3 seconds and gain Gold based on damage dealt.
  • Dark Harvest: Damaging a low Health champion inflicts adaptive damage and harvests a soul from the victim.

1039.name: Frost Wraith
1039.tooltip: <keywordMajor>Autocast</keywordMajor> <status>Root</status> nearby enemies for @RootDuration@ seconds every @Cooldown@ seconds.

1041.name: Goliath
1041.tooltip: Become large, gaining <scaleHealth>35% Health</scaleHealth> and <scaleAF>15% Adaptive Force</scaleAF>.

1044.name: Ice Cold
1044.tooltip: Your <status>Slowing</status> effects reduce <speed>Movement Speed</speed> by an extra 75.

1045.name: Infernal Conduit
1045.tooltip:
Your Abilities apply an infinitely stacking Burn, dealing @BleedDamagePerSecond@ magic damage per second for 3 seconds.
All your Burn effects lower your basic Ability Cooldowns by 0.08 seconds when they damage enemy champions.

Cooldown Time Refunded:
